column7: IssueLease vs DeleteProject across replicas: a lease inserted while the #369 cascade disabled its config was never listed by the post-commit revocation, leaving a live database credential under a deleted project until TTL. CreateDynamicSecretLease now inserts an active lease then re-reads the config (enabled) FOR SHARE in one transaction and rolls back if disabled; IssueLease revokes the minted credential (INV-STORE-21); single-process half: TestCreateDynamicSecretLease_ActiveRefusedOnDisabledConfig
